patch.summary:
Thesis: Overlapping use cases, different tradeoffs — OpenPhone and SaneBox share buyer workflows; choose based on documented strengths and limits.

Frame: Overlapping use cases, different tradeoffs — OpenPhone and SaneBox share buyer workflows; choose based on documented strengths and limits.. Choose OpenPhone only if your buying job matches “Modern SMB shared business phone (also branded Quo) with shared numbers, SMS and Sona AI —” rather than SaneBox's shape. Choose SaneBox only if your buying job matches “SaneBox is inbox-productivity tooling that layers onto an existing mailbox — Gmail, Outloo” rather than OpenPhone's shape. Workflow advantage: OpenPhone leans business-phone, sales-calling; SaneBox leans shared coverage. Trade-off: you gain focus on one product's motion at the cost of the other's adjacent coverage — no universal winner.

Major differences:
- Buyer thesis: Overlapping use cases, different tradeoffs — OpenPhone and SaneBox share buyer workflows; choose based on documented strengths and limits.
- Positioning: OpenPhone is Modern SMB shared business phone (also branded Quo) with shared numbers, SMS and Sona AI — Starter from $15/user/month annual.; SaneBox is SaneBox is inbox-productivity tooling that layers onto an existing mailbox — Gmail, Outlook, Yahoo, iCloud or any IMAP account — and triages.
- Company-size focus: OpenPhone (solo, small-business, mid-market) vs SaneBox (solo, micro, small-business).
- Workflow coverage skew: OpenPhone-leaning business-phone, sales-calling vs SaneBox-leaning —.
- Researched limits: OpenPhone — US/Canada-centric calling footprint — not a global UCaaS carrier story; SaneBox — Not a communication channel — SaneBox triages an existing mailbox and adds no voice, SMS, WhatsApp or chat.

Limitations — OpenPhone: US/Canada-centric calling footprint — not a global UCaaS carrier story; Phone menus, automatic recording and deeper CRM require Business or above; SaneBox: Not a communication channel — SaneBox triages an existing mailbox and adds no voice, SMS, WhatsApp or chat; Billing is per person with no team or family plan, so multi-user rollouts multiply cost.

Poor-fit cases: OpenPhone is a poor fit when that limitation bites: US/Canada-centric calling footprint — not a global UCaaS carrier story · SaneBox is a poor fit when that limitation bites: Not a communication channel — SaneBox triages an existing mailbox and adds no voice, SMS, WhatsApp or chat · Avoid OpenPhone if you actually need SaneBox's motion (SaneBox is inbox-productivity tooling that layers onto an existing mailbox — Gma)

Neither product has a completed hands-on product test on SoftwareGlimpse — this comparison is research/data-based only.
